scope: Read-only binding to completed records; no physical execution or missing-state reconstruction

core.step: step(action, phase, *, commit=None, resource_input=None, memory_fee=0., detect=False) -> row, receipt

public_scope_note: Host exposes active and pending configuration even though d3 prepare passes a narrower view. Empty current resource does not make complete public inputs history-free.
physical_order: Before-step observation, weights and memory fee requested
At due clock: pending matures into active
At phase4: target from old rho times commit weights once; affordable commitment retires old ability and creates pending due eight steps later
Basal and requested movement paid; actual integer shift and keep applied to old tissue and ability
At phase12: detection requested and paid on eligible mature old support
Local labels on completed mask and actual uptake generated
Born allocated to M20; rejected material, spill and remaining resource exit booked; newborn ability zero
Host returns row/receipt at post-step clock; controller transports and may update memory

clock.normal_pre_action_resource: empty; pulse enters and exits within phase12 step

valid_local_observation.conditions: phase12, detect requested, port cell, survivor>1e-12, active>=.02*survivor, detect_paid>=detect_requested
valid_local_observation.writer_separate_conditions: d3 also requires previously paid cue support and memory_unpaid==0 to update. Writer refusal does not invalidate an otherwise paid detection.
valid_local_observation.no_global_substitution: Total uptake, another location, or private tape cannot create a missing local observation

ce2.coverage: Per-step scalar rows; selected post-phase4/12 body, policy and real full receipt arrays; history probe common full checkpoint, exact imported policy and post-commit/post-arrival snapshots
ce2.missing: Full every-decision pre-choice public/history stream was not saved. Common checkpoint equality and saved receipt checks are narrower than a complete information-partition audit.

d3.sampled_frames: First heldout seed 202610187201, changed condition, phases0/4/12/31; 832 saved frames
d3.frame_timing: After host step AND controller.settle; prediction is post-update. phase4 requested is the actual commitment weight, other phases carry last_requested.
d3.complete_checkpoints: Stage final packets contain env.checkpoint and controller.checkpoint; source stage paths and hashes in stages.json
missing_in_sampled_frame: full controller state before and after write
d3.restriction: Do not infer missing arrays by inverting body state, actual_v or frozen equations. No extra rerun requested.

opaque_ids: No opaque decision_id/event_id was emitted by host. Read-only adapter may hash source-file SHA plus stored stage/clock/cell as a provenance join key. This is an index, not a new observed event or new clock measurement.
ordinal_order: Source-derived within-step ordinals may document payment/open/completion order; they are not recorded wall-clock timestamps.
